summary: This Dockerfile creates a web server image based on nginx, installs the openssl tool for SSL/TLS support, and then copies in SSL certificate files and a custom nginx configuration file so the server can handle HTTPS traffic with the specified settings.

explanations.3: The backslash at the end of the line lets us continue the same RUN command on the next line, which keeps the Docker image smaller by running everything as one layer instead of multiple separate commands.
explanations.5: This removes the temporary package cache files that apt-get left behind, which reduces the final image size since we don't need them anymore.
explanations.7: This copies the SSL certificate file from our local ssl folder into the nginx container at the path where nginx expects to find certificates for HTTPS.
